name: s81hc_retcol_c0_ref
why_floorplan: Return column 0 = ctra_column + ctrb_column (COLUMN 0, YB_STAGE 1, PAYLOAD_STAGE 0) merged into one 144.18 x 72.90 leaf (10-16: grown from 56.16, post-CTS util 75-79% at 56.16); Codex A/B maps 2431+1916 um2 class.

job.purpose: New cth_ntc return leaf, COLUMN 0: the four-column return with the y-beat / cs relays (y returns +1, requests and h returns unchanged).
job.hold_merge: cth_ntc parent component: the parent kit binds it after every child closes with native PASS; exactness = two-row chain proof + exact HC gate (RETCOL)
job.no_bench_reason: Exactness at row / slab level: results/rtl/s81_return_columns_1015/row_proof (two-row chain vs the cth_nt monolithic return, same cycle, 5 mutants) and the exact HC gate with RETCOL 1; a leaf-only bench cannot model the column-to-column y / cs relays.

pin_regs.reason: Real RTL registers the boundary at its own stage (chain rd/rv -> rdq/rvq, y beat / cs relays, ybuf / psb captures, rdm / header / request / flag registers); a generic pin register would add a cycle to the fixed return calendar. hrq feeds the same-cycle merge (bank round trip) by design.

structural_change: Replaces the failed monolithic ctra / ctrb strips (v1 GRT congestion; native capture 674 ps): one engine per column, y beat and cs relayed one cycle, own payload chunks only.
slot_change_request: New cth_ntc leaf (top-down parent plan tools/s81/hc_cthntc_plan.py, physical/s81_die_pins/v28_hc_cthntc: outline growth 10-16: parent 576.72 x 874.26).
